eod.conclusion: Markets closed lower after failing to sustain early gains, with both major indices declining. The session saw volatile swings as investors weighed corporate earnings prospects against broader economic concerns. While some individual stocks benefited from deal activity, most sectors faced pressure, particularly in the broader market. Currency and crypto markets reflected cautious sentiment despite intermittent rallies during the trading day.
